meta.title: Branding & White-labeling — org ≠ workspace
meta.subtitle: Deploy-time org identity, resolved once above the auth/tenancy planes (doc 13)

boundaries.label: resolved once at deploy/build — above the auth/tenancy planes (not per-request, not tenant-scoped)

cards.title: Organization ≠ workspace
items: Organization = the deploying customer (Trellix); owns branding; ONE deployment per org; resolved once at build/deploy
Workspace = a tenant within the org (trellix-xdr, …); owns agents/knowledge; resolved per request
orgs is branding-only — it is NOT a tenant dimension (no org_id-scoped logic; see doc 15 §1)

cards.title: Where org config lives (FE)
items: src/lib/org.ts → the OrgBrand shape: orgName, productName, idpName, emailDomain, docsDomain, logo
src/app/brand.css → visual tokens (accent for dark+light, --radius, --font-*) — one source of truth, merged by Tailwind @theme

cards.title: Backend shape (when services/ is built)
items: 1 (recommended, matches one-deploy-per-org): bake org config at build/deploy via env / org.config.json — no endpoint, no per-request cost
2 (only if you go multi-tenant): GET /v1/branding — a small cacheable public endpoint returning OrgBrand + token values; explicitly out of scope today
Either way the OrgBrand shape is unchanged — same drop-in mock→backend pattern

cards.title: Not branding · caveat
items: Workspaces + metrics stay backend-owned (09, 01); membership/roles are IdP claims; the trellix-* seeds are demo content (@backend remove)
Status colors + the dataviz s2–s8 series are brand-neutral — never themed per org
Caveat: the typeface can't be pure config — next/font needs a static import, so a font change edits layout.tsx
